bibl.seg: Betsy M. Bryan, Art-Making in Texts and Contexts.

Richard Jasnow & Ghislaine Widmer (edd.), Illuminating Osiris. Egyptological Studies in Honor of Mark Smith = Material and Visual Culture of Ancient Egypt. 2 (Atlanta, Georgia, 2017) pp. 1-21, figg. et pll. 1-3; - 389.
bibl.note: See in part. pp. 13-17: Description of a Shrine. Discusses P. Vindob. Dem. Inv. 10100 [ed.: Günter Vittmann, Ein Entwurf zur Dekoration, Enchoria 28 (2002/2003) pp. 106-136, figg.]. This Roman period demotic text is a detailed description of the decoration and inscriptions of a shrine in the temple to Sobek, at Dimai in the Fayum.
